title: trema guineense var. asperatum
intro: Trema guineense var. asperatum, commonly known as Guinea trema or West African trema, is a plant species in the family Cannabaceae. It is a shrub or small tree that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The leaves of this plant have been found to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Trema guineense var. asperatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
